explanation: Cone volume scales as r²h. Radius down 20% → 0.8r (area factor 0.64); height up 50% → 1.5h. Net multiplier 0.64 × 1.5 = 0.96, i.e. a 4% volume decrease. Treating only radius or only height in isolation lands on the 20% distractors.
